capabilities: View and embed art files (.kra, .psd, .ai, .clip) in notes and Canvas
Render 3D models (.obj, .gltf, .glb, .stl) with camera and spin options
Configure embeds with width, height, camera position and scale settings
Toggle supported file types on or off in the settings
disambiguation: Not an editor for these formats; it only displays and embeds them, and editing is explicitly out of scope.
extras: The README notes that 3D objects are placed at origin (0, 0, 0) and scaled to fit a unit cube, and that spin animation disables camera position settings.
problem: Obsidian cannot display or embed many art program and 3D model file formats, so users must open them in external applications.
summary: File viewer plugin that adds viewing and embedding support for art and 3D file types like .kra, .psd, .ai, .clip, .obj, .gltf, .glb and .stl.
